title: St. Frances Xavier Cabrini, Virgin
subtitle: Memorial (USA) · 2 Jn 4-9; Lk 17:26-37
text: Mother Cabrini wanted to be a missionary to China, but Pope Leo XIII sent her west to the Italian immigrants of America instead. She founded schools, orphanages and hospitals across the country and became the first U.S. citizen to be canonized. Her obedience became her mission.
